\begin{example} \end{example}[Characteristics for conservation laws] ↗ thm:local-existence-characteristics 1. ch3:3.2-ex-5\group Conservation Laws

For \[ u_t+\operatorname {div}F(u)=0, \] the projected characteristic from $x^0$ is \[ x(t)=x^0+tF'(g(x^0)),\qquad u(x(t),t)=g(x^0). \] Crossing projected characteristics obstruct a global smooth solution. \end{example}
